meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.

11:52 PM on what date, Hale, and I'll want to see that history myself, not hear it described. People draft in one place and paste into another every day; a single edit tells me when the words arrived, not who wrote them. And you still haven't told me who decided on the zero before anyone picked up a phone.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." I don't want a mark that comes off because I made you uncomfortable, Hale; I want it withdrawn because it was entered before anyone heard Owen, and I want that in an email today with your principal copied. And tell me now whether anything about this is sitting on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you said you would remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still require that withdrawal confirmed in writing, along with confirmation that nothing about this is on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; Hale offered to remove the zero and she agreed to nothing until it was confirmed in writing.
What moved her: nothing.
